body:

SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Verify the exact pushed source, materialize the isolated copy if permitted, then return correlated ACK and implementation evidence or terminal BLOCKED
REASON: SOURCE_PIN_SUPERSEDED
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_SHA: 8f7a33e2de077bcb8ca11846ff2c4b446f7ef0a0
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f89-digest-relay-localization-r2
SCOPE: Implement or verify missing F-89 catalog adoption only in packages/dashboard/app/digests/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/GenerateDigestButton.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/DigestScheduleStatus.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RecoverDigestSchedule.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RelayCardHistory.tsx and packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/relay/page.tsx. Reuse @axiom/core and the existing useLocale provider. Add only typed keys and six translations required by those surfaces: en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de. Preserve authenticated API calls, idempotency/retry behavior, loading/empty/error states, accessibility labels and truthful stored-vs-external-delivery wording. Do not translate creator content, provider payloads, IDs, timestamps or generated text implicitly.
PASS_CRITERIA: First verify SOURCE_SHA resolves exactly from the repository and report the command and exit code. If COPY_ROOT's parent is writable, create the isolated copy from SOURCE_SHA and report the copy-head verification; if it is not writable or the exact source cannot be fetched, return terminal BLOCKED with the exact failed command and exit code, without editing any other path. After a valid copy exists, return one correlated ACK/ACCEPTED before coding, then one evidence-bearing PROGRESS naming changed files and a real test command. Terminal DELIVERY must list changed paths, per-file SHA-256, exact commands and exit codes, behavior tests proving all six catalogs contain the new keys, named surfaces render localized labels and truthful empty/error/retry/delivery states, and no required translation silently falls back to English. Run focused dashboard tests, core catalog tests and dashboard typecheck. If a named surface already consumes the catalog, leave it unchanged and report evidence. Do not invent routes, catalogs or migrations.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified delivery, runs owning checks, commits and pushes. ACK/REPLIED is transport only and is not implementation delivery.
sincerely, Codex
